title: Family and Friends
label: ch:ka-family-and-friends
canDo: I can name my family as a group in Kannada and name a friend, and say which of the two words is native and which is a Sanskrit loan.

payoff.summary: Say ಇದು ನನ್ನ ಕುಟುಂಬ and ಇವನು ನನ್ನ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತ, trace kuṭumba and snēhita back to Sanskrit, and set snēhita beside the native pair ಗೆಳೆಯ/ಗೆಳತಿ.
